Without leaving your work.

Desk mode, for the long stretches.

One key turns the screen into a quiet room: the clock, what you have earned and your companion at its desk.

What else is in there.

  • Rates that change over time

    Give each rate a start date and Clockin pays old work at the rate it was earned at. Amounts show in your currency with a Turkish lira equivalent.

  • Your timecard, imported

    Bring in a CSV or paste the text straight from a timecard page. Clockin compares it with what you already have and refuses to double a day.

  • Goals that know your pace

    Set daily and monthly hours and how many days a week you work. Progress shows what is left and the time you will reach today’s goal.

  • A companion that keeps you company

    The pixel mascot reacts to your work, levels up, earns coins, and has a wardrobe and a room you can arrange.

  • Focus chime and radio

    A gentle chime on the interval you pick, eight sounds to choose from, and internet radio while you work.

  • Your iPhone and Mac, in step

    Work, goals, companion and settings move between your devices through your own iCloud. There is no Clockin account and no server.

And in your pocket.

The iPhone app keeps the same work and the same companion. The Lock Screen Live Activity and the Dynamic Island show the money going up, with pause and clock out right there, and the widgets keep today in view. It is in testing now.

Here’s to a good day’s work.
